decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The pitched roofs of the two blocks of flats shall not be used to create additional floorspace on the site without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The applicant is advised that no changes should be made to the development as approved without first consulting with, and getting the agreement of, the Local Planning Authority.
description: Replacement of existing flat roofs of two blocks of 3 and 4 storey flats by hipped roofs with additional roof extensions to enclose service/maintenance/access areas at roof level
